title: Revert response
description: What the revert page posts after the passkey signs: the body of POST /api/v1/reverts/{revertId}/apply, on the engine's own pages or through the Vault. It is never shown to paste. Byte fields are base64url without padding. Any relay may carry it; basalt_meta.apply_revert verifies it and runs the revert. See CONTRACT.md, Revert.
